evidence: artificial intelligence is further streamlining frontline workflows by providing insights and delivering actions using on-device vision, audio, location and RFID to automate parts of traditional workflows

We are leveraging artificial intelligence to automate the detailed generation of tasks within complex workflows, bring knowledge and product companions to workers and deliver conversational interfaces
Our offerings integrate smart-connected sensors, RFID, and advanced software to provide actionable, data-driven insights
Leveraging a combination of on-device and cloud-based AI, smart context-aware software companions are beginning to augment worker productivity
ai_positioning.summary: Zebra positionne l'IA comme composant intégré de ses solutions de workflow et d'automatisation frontline, combinant vision par ordinateur, IA on-device et cloud pour augmenter la productivité des travailleurs. L'entreprise utilise l'IA pour automatiser les tâches et fournir des insights actionnables, sans développer ses propres modèles fondamentaux.
